final: WITH cat_stats AS (SELECT category, COUNT(*) as line_count, AVG(CASE WHEN spent > 0 THEN (spent - amount) / NULLIF(amount, 0) END) as avg_relative_overspend FROM budget GROUP BY category), avg_line_count AS (SELECT AVG(line_count) as avg_lc FROM cat_stats) SELECT AVG(cs.avg_relative_overspend) as avg_relative_overspend, AVG(cs.line_count) as avg_line_count, AVG(cs.line_count - alc.avg_lc) as avg_excess_lines FROM cat_stats cs CROSS JOIN avg_line_count alc WHERE cs.line_count > alc.avg_lc
